d:
Diwali aur Bhai Dooj par Gangapur wali Khir Mohan (khir mohan) ghar par banayein!
Sirf 1 litre doodh aur 1 cup cheeni se, bina extra rang daale gehra caramel colour. Poonam Devnani ki no fail recipe, Masala Kitchen par.
Khir Mohan ke liye chhena kaise banayein: sirke se doodh phaadna, dhona aur nichodna
Chhene ke andar ka paani nikalne ki Poonam ki trick, taaki ball ka shape na bigde
2 tsp barik suji se bina crack ke ball, na maida, na baking powder, na arrowroot
Caramel chashni mein 40-45 minute pakane ka sahi tarika
